description: Use when the user wants to find a venue by name, city, or area on XP (e.g. 'venues near me', 'arenas in Brooklyn', 'what's at the venue level downtown'). Returns venue records from the XP marketplace catalog — not tickets. Do not use to answer ticket-price questions once the event is known; call `get_ticket_listings` instead.

city.description: Optional city filter (synonyms: near me, area).

metro.description: Optional metro area filter (synonyms: city, near me, area).

name: search_venues
title: Search Venues
